evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never delivered the time-boxed framing ('This will take about 10 to 15 minutes') and dependable-quote promise before launching into probing. Jumped straight to confirming details without the opening ritual.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: Angela Kong; Moving day: November 6th; Route: 801 Sugar Ray Avenue, Austin, Texas 78757 to 6800 Austin Center Boulevard, Austin, Texas; Size: 700 sq ft apartment to 1000 sq ft apartment. All four present.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked 'Besides pricing, do you have any questions or concerns you would like answered on this call?' — but this came after already confirming the date and contact info, and only after Angela had already said yes to the initial call. Asked late in the discovery flow, not before probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Angela said 'I don't think so. But I'm sure we can go through it.' No concerns were actually raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns were raised by the customer, so N/A applies. No reflection was needed because nothing was to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floors (first floor at both locations), mattress size (queen), TV size (~70 inches), special items (couch, bed frame, mattress, TV), parking access (easy at origin; 56 steps at destination), box count range (15–25 boxes). Nearly all seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provided typical move time range (2.5 to 3.5 hours for two movers, one truck) and personalized it to Angela's move: 'I definitely feel like you would fall within that range.' Price range given: $550–$770. Both anchor and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep disclosed hourly rate ($220/hour for two movers, 26-foot truck on Nov 6), what's included (fuel, truck, taxes, insurance, wraps, pads, protective items, tools), and the 2.5-hour minimum with 15-minute increments: 'The way the clock works is the time starts as soon as we get on site and open that contract, you then have us for as long as you need us for any move. We do have a two and a half hour minimum once we go over that minimum. The time is pro rated in fifteen minute increments.' No deposit/cancellation fees mentioned. Disclosure present and comprehensive.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or any version of that closing check. Moved directly from pricing into availability windows and the ask for business.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep stated: 'We value your time. So, if we can't make it in a time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' The discount-immediately framing is present.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep stated: 'We do have that no worries, damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in our hourly rate provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.' Covers the $2,000 amount and 'included in our hourly rate' (not an add-on). Missing explicit 'no deductible/no fine print' framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or a version of that question. The Two Promises section moved directly into availability and pricing details without a closing check.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked 'And then do you have any other questions for me?' — this is a genuine enough version of the final check, not the empty 'any questions?' throwaway.
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: Angela raised a real concern: 'I need to confirm the that I can actually take that day off of work and then I can call back and confirm a question regarding like larger items for like night stands and dressers, do you need me to take everything out?' Rep dug in: 'Yes, we do prefer you all to take everything out of the drawers just for liability it makes the items heavier and then just, that way your items don't get damaged when moving.' Real follow-up present.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' Not asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asked: 'Would you like us to help you with that moved on Friday November 6th.' This is a plain, direct ask with no softened-out version offered. Angela said 'Yes. Let me think about it some more' — she didn't immediately confirm but the ask was clear and unambiguous.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep stated: 'And then there's no deposit required to get on our schedule and no charges or fees to change or cancel if need be.' Rate-lock language ('no charges or fees to change or cancel') present.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirmed: date (November 6th, Friday), arrival window (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM and 12:30 to 2:30), phone number (confirmed at top of call: 832-791-9188), addresses (both locations confirmed). Missing: crew size (not explicitly confirmed — 'two movers' was stated as typical but not confirmed for this booking), and notes/concerns handed to crew. Partial — 4 of 5 items confirmed.

top_strength: Excellent discovery and logistics probing — rep gathered all seven key details (property type, floors, room count, parking, special items, mattress/TV sizes, box count) with natural follow-up questions and personalized the estimate to Angela's specific move profile and prep level.
coaching_note: Open the call with the full quid pro quo framing and time-box before any probing starts — rep skipped straight into confirming details without the 'takes 10 to 15 minutes, you'll walk away with a quote you can depend on' setup and wait-for-yes.
